cmd_additem: Gives an item to a player by citizen ID, online or offline

cmd_arg_count_give: The amount of the item to give
cmd_arg_type_set: Sets the "type" metadata to the value
cmd_removeitem: Removes an item from a player by citizen ID, online or offline
cmd_arg_target_remove: Citizen ID of the player to remove the item from (#5 = server ID 5)
cmd_arg_count_take: The amount of the item to take
cmd_arg_type_match: Only remove items with a matching metadata "type"

cmd_arg_target_set: Citizen ID of the player to set the items for (#5 = server ID 5)
cmd_arg_count_set: The amount of items to set
cmd_arg_type_setitem: Add or remove items with the metadata "type"
cmd_clearevidence: Clears a police evidence locker with the given id
cmd_takeinv: Confiscates the target inventory, to restore with /restoreinv
cmd_arg_target_confiscate: Citizen ID of the player to confiscate items from (#5 = server ID 5)

cmd_clearinv: Wipes all items from the target inventory
cmd_arg_inv_wipe: Citizen ID (#5 = server ID 5, me = yourself) or an inventory id

cmd_arg_lock: Lock inventory access, until restart or saved without a lock

cmd_arg_inv_inspect: Citizen ID (#5 = server ID 5) or an inventory id
